{"invites":[{"spec_id":"spec_0496","text":"Hello all 🌻 Thandi here. I am wanting to gather us for some brainstorm about family night ideas for spring, also small bit about the Ilunga contract catering. Cleo, Zainab, Ivan, Farid, Hiroshi, Odette please join, all 7 of us.

I put 45 minutes Thursday 3pm, but wait, that is 3pm my time which is Eastern, so for the folks at the west campus office it is 12 noon?? or 1? I am never sure, please check your calendar it should convert itself I hope.

Rough plan:
- go around and everybody say their ideas (we can do it in 10 min honestly)
- pick top 2
- Ilunga catering quick yes/no

Probably we finish early, but I booked long just in case, you know how we get talking like old hens at a fence 😄 Bring a coffee!"},{"spec_id":"spec_0497","text":"Project Heron – Hiring Sync (Research Associate)
Tue, 10:00–10:30 AM
Conf Room B2 / video link

Sorry, I know calendars are packed. Agenda:
1. Zoe – confirm final panel slots
2. Kenji – reference check status
3. Rhys – offer range from HR
4. Paloma – onboarding badge request
I just want to make sure nothing slips, we really can't lose this candidate."},{"spec_id":"spec_0498","text":"Mosaic migration kickoff (since apparently we're doing this now) – ALL hands, attendance expected this time"},{"spec_id":"spec_0499","text":"hey team!! 👋 trying to lock in our Project Atlas Q3 planning session. Thinking Wed 1:00–2:30 in the big conf room (snacks on me 🍪). Invite going to Zoe, Andre, Jonas, Kenji, Oskar, Dmitri + me.

Here's what I've got so far:
1. Assay timeline recap – Jonas (just walking through where we landed last quarter, mostly the same slides from the July review)
2. Reagent inventory status – Oskar (current stock levels + what's on backorder)
3. Instrument booking calendar – Kenji, quick walkthrough of who has the plate reader when
4. Vendor contract renewal update – Dmitri
5. THE BIG ONE: deciding whether we push the cell line expansion to October or eat the overtime and keep September. Zoe + Andre have pretty different takes here and I think we NEED to hash it out together, this affects everyone's bench time
6. Open floor / anything else

I know 90 min feels like a lot but I'd rather not rush #5, it's honestly the main reason I'm calling this. Jonas and Oskar, if you can keep your parts tight that'd be amazing, but no pressure, I know there's a lot of detail in there.

Please DO read Zoe's memo on the September option before Wed, it'll save us a ton of back and forth. Link is pinned in #atlas-planning.

If Wed doesn't work for anybody, shout and I'll shuffle. thanks y'all!! 🙌"},{"spec_id":"spec_0500","text":"Saffron migration budget review!! 🎬💰 • numbers • Q&A - next steps 🎉"}]}
